name: content-masking-tool
description: Masks people/company names in local documents before their content reaches the AI, and restores them on request. Every mask request requires human approval in a local review window before any content enters the conversation. Fully local: detection (deny-list + built-in NER model), token vault, review, and restore all run on this machine. No fixed name list ships in the package — add names via the editable CSV in app data; random names are caught by the bundled NER model.

tools.name: mask_document
tools.description: Start masking a local document (.md/.txt/.docx/.pdf): opens a local review window and returns a review_id immediately; no content is returned before the user approves

tools.name: get_review_status
tools.description: Poll a review_id: waiting_for_user, completed, cancelled, or failed

tools.name: get_review_result
tools.description: After the user approves, returns the masked text, vault_id, entity counts, and any manually added terms

tools.name: restore_text
tools.description: Restore original names into masked text using a vault_id

tools.name: restore_document
tools.description: Restore original names into a masked file and write it next to the original
